dispositions.evidence: Added _v1_protected in categorise.py: when a profile name matches a line under the frozen table, v1's protected-verdict rules decide first, in table order. notes: v1.yaml's bytes are pinned, so v1's protected-verdict set lives in code (_V1_PROTECTED, _V1_PROTECTED_IN). v1's non_trading_in rule also matches INTEREST, GRANT, INSURANCE CLAIM and bare CAPITAL and SAVINGS. Those are not protected verdicts by the term (D48: bare words are not evidence), so with a profile name they do not outrank it. The verifier may read that differently. v1's protected rules are read only when a profile name matches, so v1 with no profile keeps its exact first-match order (R54).
